mechanism_narrative: The Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) level is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, so higher inflation rates predict negative returns regardless of the current inflation level.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above its 5-year rolling median, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market that depresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as measured by the interaction between the federal funds rate and inflation.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) shows a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of instances when the real rate is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1050 thousand units, it signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1050.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong demand environment, indicated by high housing starts (HOUST) and high retail sales (RSAFS), predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as measured by the interaction between these two demand indicators.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) shows a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 5-year rolling medians.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production (INDPRO) level is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, so higher industrial production predicts positive returns regardless of the current industrial production level.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 5-year rolling median, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month growth rate in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS 3-month growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
